headline: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods appear in leaked video
summary: Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods appeared in a leaked video. The footage, found in a macOS Tahoe release, shows a user holding a book for 'Visual Intelligence'. This offers a first glimpse of the new technology.

headline: Reddit's AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio and video. The new feature uses AI voices to read posts and comments aloud. This aims to offer new content consumption methods for users.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show. The program highlights stories trending on social media and web searches. It began airing in April on ABC News Live.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99. This 65-percent keyboard is a great entry point for custom keyboard enthusiasts. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING at checkout on Woot.

headline: Deus Ex, System Shock, and Thief Developer Legend Warren Spector Announces Retirement
summary: Legendary video game developer Warren Spector has announced his retirement. He is renowned for his work on titles like Deus Ex, System Shock, and Thief. His departure marks a significant moment in the gaming industry.

headline: Marvel Boss Kevin Feige Teases 'Sagas Upon Sagas' of X-Men Movies, With Young Cast Ready for '100 More'
summary: Marvel boss Kevin Feige teases expansive future plans for X-Men movies. He hinted at 'sagas upon sagas' with potential for '100 more' films. The current young cast is reportedly poised for a long cinematic run.

headline: gamescom awesome indies show: How to Watch
summary: Details are available on how to watch the gamescom awesome indies show. This guide provides all necessary information for viewers. Prepare to see highlights from various independent game developers.

headline: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p portable USB monitor is currently on sale. It's ideal as a secondary display for laptops. It also doubles as a portable screen for consoles like Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: Russia warns UK will pay for supplying drones to Ukraine
summary: Russia issued a warning to the UK over supplying drones used in Ukraine strikes. Moscow accuses the UK of escalating the conflict. The UK Ministry of Defence affirms its stance against Russian aggression.

headline: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors
summary: IVF staff in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents. Multiple children may have been conceived using unselected sperm and egg donors. Concerns have been raised regarding donor identity transparency.

headline: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
summary: A British couple, Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert, died in a helicopter crash in Greece. The newlyweds were on their honeymoon when the incident occurred. Their Greek pilot was also killed in the crash.

headline: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
summary: German authorities raided a secret police warehouse, targeting smuggling gangs. They seized dinghies and life jackets under a new anti-smuggling law. Germany is cracking down on groups facilitating illegal immigration.
